descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Senior Partnership Development Manager di Climeworks, la vostra missione è quella di sviluppare nuove partnership con aziende leader in tutta Europa e guidare la crescita del business. Si priorità & sviluppare il go-to-market e pipeline strategicamente, consigliare le aziende sul loro viaggio net-zero e il business case per Carbon Removal, negoziare e stretti accordi di partnership, e orchestrare la gestione clienti di livello mondiale.
• Go-To-Market & Pipeline Development: Tu guida il go-to-market e sviluppi la tua pipeline identificando e privilegiando i conti promettenti, connettendosi a stakeholder chiave, e costruendo relazioni forti su tutti i livelli di anzianità.
• Market Presence & Outreach: Tu rappresenti Climeworks Solutions nelle principali conferenze ed eventi del settore, avvia campagne di comunicazione e sfrutta reti interne e personali per creare nuove opportunità.
• Customer Solutions & Propost Development: Tu guida il processo di offerta analizzando le esigenze dei clienti e le strategie climatiche, costruendo portafogli di rimozione del carbonio su misura e supportando lo sviluppo di casi aziendali con esperti multifunzionali.
• Sviluppo del partenariato: mantieni e cresci relazioni con le alleanze del settore che contribuiscono al successo commerciale.
• Leadership della negoziazione: Lei conduce fasi di negoziazione, coordinando gli input di tutti i dipartimenti e specialisti rilevanti.
• Gestione account e consegna: il successo del cliente, supervisiona la consegna dei crediti di rimozione del carbonio, e fornisce informazioni di mercato e portafoglio rilevanti per i clienti. Requisiti:
• Motivation & Mindset: Sei entusiasta di contribuire a costruire un nuovo settore a basso impatto climatico con potenziale trilioni di dollari e sono motivati a crescere un business di successo nello spazio di rimozione del carbonio accanto a un team dedicato e collaborativo.
• Sfondo educativo: Hai completato una laurea in Business Administration, Sostenibilità, Clima, Ingegneria o un campo correlato; un grado avanzato (Master o equivalente) è un vantaggio.
• Esperienza professionale: Lei porta 8+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di conti aziendali complessi attraverso lo sviluppo aziendale, partenariati strategici, vendite consultive B2B, o come Key Account Director. Idealmente avete esperienza nella costruzione di nuovi mercati e sono confortevoli operanti in ambienti di start-up o scale-up, tra cui la creazione di strutture e processi.
• Leadership & competenze commerciali: Lei dimostra forti capacità di leadership con la capacità di ispirare e costruire la fiducia con i clienti. Sei un networker forte, analiticamente ragionato, e strategicamente guidato, con esperienza nell'organizzazione di attività di go-to-market tra team e solide capacità di gestione del progetto.
• Lingua e comunicazione: Hai eccellenti competenze in inglese (C2). Sei un comunicatore coinvolgente, fiducioso nel parlare pubblico, e in grado di creare narrazioni chiare, strutturate e convincenti. Come lavoriamo: a Climeworks, promuoviamo una cultura altamente collaborativa in cui il lavoro di squadra, la fiducia e lo scambio aperto sono al centro di come operiamo. Valoriamo l'agilità e prendiamo le decisioni rapidamente, consentendo ai nostri team di muoversi velocemente in avanti. Siamo guidati da un forte “can-do” e da uno spirito imprenditoriale. La nostra ambizione è audace, e ci abbina con una mentalità pragmatica e orientata all'azione per trasformare le idee in impatto. Il nostro popolo è profondamente impegnato nel loro lavoro e nella nostra missione condivisa, ispirando gli altri attraverso ciò che facciamo e come lo facciamo. La nostra promessa: A Climeworks, siete accettati per chi siete, e ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente inclusivo dove tutti si sentono apprezzati. Incoraggiamo tutti i candidati qualificati ad applicare – indipendentemente da background, identità o esperienza. Gli studi dimostrano che le donne e gli individui provenienti da background minoritari spesso si applicano solo per i posti di lavoro quando soddisfano il 100% dei criteri elencati. Se questo suona come te, non tenere indietro. Se pensate di fare una grande misura per questo ruolo, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi, anche se non si controlla ogni singola scatola. Cerchiamo di affrontare insieme una delle sfide più grandi del genere umano. Cosa offriamo:
• Time Off: Godetevi 25 giorni di vacanza pagati ogni anno, più festivi.
• Flessibilità: lavorare come si adatta meglio. Offriamo una configurazione di lavoro ibrida e fino a 4 settimane di lavoro remoto ogni anno in qualsiasi paese dell'UE.
• ProprietÃ: la base giusta paga accoppiata con un pacchetto azionario – perché i vostri contributi sono importanti.
• Supporto familiare: congedo parentale incluso.
• Apprendimento continuo: bilancio dedicato per investire nella vostra crescita professionale.
• Referral Rewards: Aiutaci a crescere il nostro team e guadagnare bonus per i tuoi referral di successo. descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Senior Partnership Development Manager at Climeworks, your mission is to develop new partnerships with leading corporates across Europe and drive the growth of the business. You prioritize & develop the go-to-market and pipeline strategically, advise companies on their net-zero journey and the business case for Carbon Removal, negotiate and close partnership agreements, and orchestrate world-class customer management.
• Go-To-Market & Pipeline Development: You lead the go-to-market and develop your own pipeline by identifying and prioritizing promising accounts, connecting to key stakeholders, and building strong relationships across all seniority levels.
• Market Presence & Outreach: You represent Climeworks Solutions at leading conferences and industry events, initiate communication campaigns, and leverage internal and personal networks to create new opportunities.
• Customer Solutions & Proposal Development: You lead the offering process by analyzing customer needs and climate strategies, building tailored carbon removal portfolios, and supporting business case development with cross-functional experts.
• Partnership Development: You maintain and grow relationships with industry alliances that contribute to commercial success.
• Negotiation Leadership: You lead negotiation phases, coordinating inputs from all relevant departments and specialists.
• Account Management & Delivery: You own customer success, oversee the delivery of carbon removal credits, and provide relevant market and portfolio insights to customers. Requirements:
• Motivation & Mindset: You are excited to help build a new, climate-relevant industry with trillion-dollar potential and are motivated to grow a successful business in the carbon removal space alongside a dedicated and collaborative team.
• Educational Background: You have completed a bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Sustainability, Climate, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (Master’s or equivalent) is a plus.
• Professional Experience: You bring 8+ years of experience in developing complex business accounts across business development, strategic partnerships, consultative B2B sales, or as a Key Account Director. You ideally have experience in building new markets and are comfortable operating in start-up or scale-up environments, including setting up structures and processes.
• Leadership & Commercial Skills: You demonstrate strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and build trust with customers. You are a strong networker, analytically minded, and strategically driven, with experience orchestrating go-to-market activities across teams and solid project management capabilities.
• Language & Communication: You have excellent English skills (C2). You are an engaging communicator, confident in public speaking, and able to craft clear, structured, and compelling narratives. How we work : At Climeworks, we foster a highly collaborative culture where teamwork, trust, and open exchange are at the core of how we operate. We value agility and make decisions quickly, empowering our teams to move fast forward. We are hands-on by nature, driven by a strong “can-do” and entrepreneurial spirit. Our ambition is bold, and we match it with a pragmatic, action-oriented mindset to turn ideas into impact. Our people are deeply committed to their work and to our shared mission, inspiring others through what we do and how we do it. Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together. What we offer:
• Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.
• Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.
• Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.
• Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.
• Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.
• Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals. Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team. Formalities:
• This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.
• We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

• Material Stability: You investigate material stability by testing under accelerated aging conditions to simulate long-term performance.
• Sorbent Characterization: You characterize sorbent behaviour by measuring unary and binary isotherms under controlled conditions.
• Independent Work: You work independently on targeted work packages to understand how material properties influence DAC performance.
• Method Development: You contribute to the development, refinement, and validation of experimental methods to ensure reliable and reproducible testing outcomes.

• Technical Skills: You enjoy working hands-on in the lab, and you have some classroom or other experience with any of the following: characterization of porous materials (N₂ adsorption, Hg porosimetry, DVS, etc.), adsorption characterization (breakthrough testing).
• Additional Knowledge: Familiarity with CO₂ capture is beneficial but not required.
• Mindset: You are eager to learn new concepts, skills, and tools that you might need to complete your assignments.
• Working Style: You are reliable, motivated, solution-oriented, concise, and have a structured working style.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In this role, you will apply deep synthetic chemistry expertise to design, synthesize and evaluate next-generation sorbent materials for Direct Air Capture. You will take scientific ownership of early-stage material innovation, connect synthesis decisions with performance data and help identify the most promising sorbent concepts for further development. You will play a central role in coordinating across stakeholders to ensure alignment of research priorities, technical development and broader organization goals. The role is ideal for a hands-on chemist who enjoys driving technical work independently while collaborating closely with experts across characterization, engineering, scale-up, legal, and external innovation. This role is a strong fit if you:
• You are a hands-on synthetic chemist, ideally with experience in material synthesis or functional material development.
• You enjoy working as an individual contributor and technical expert, while effectively coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders.
• You want to stay close to lab-based experimentation, synthesis, characterization, and scientific problem-solving.
• You are motivated by early-stage R&D and material innovation, with a passion for dynamic, discovery-driven environments. What you will do:
• Design and synthesize new sorbent materials: You develop and improve sorbent chemistries for Direct Air Capture, with a focus on performance, durability, cost and scalability.
• Evaluate material performance: You plan experiments, analyze characterization and adsorption data, and connect synthesis decisions with structure-property relationships.
• Identify promising concepts: You screen internal and external sorbent concepts against clear technical, commercial, regulatory, scalability, and IP-related criteria.
• Drive hands-on laboratory work: You run safe, well-documented synthesis and testing campaigns, maintain structured material data, and translate results into recommendations.
• Collaborate and coordinate across disciplines: You work closely with experts in characterization, engineering, scale-up, legal, patents and external innovation to move the most promising sorbent concepts forward. Requirements:
• Synthetic chemistry expertise: You have strong hands-on experience in synthetic organic or inorganic chemistry. You have experience in porous, functionalized, polymeric or amine-based. Experience with other sorbent-relevant materials is a plus.
• Relevant experience: You bring at least 5 years of experience in synthetic chemistry, material synthesis or material development, including applied R&D, start-up, industrial or technology development experience.
• Chemistry background: You hold an advanced degree in organic, inorganic, synthetic, materials chemistry or a related field. A PhD is a plus.
• Scientific ownership: You are comfortable leading your own workstreams, interpreting data critically and translating findings into clear recommendations.
• Clear communication: You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and are proficient in English.
